description: Billing module whose computeInvoiceTotals and computeCreditNoteTotals each re-implement the same per-line discount, tax and rounding rule under different variable names; a change to the rule must be made in both places

hard.note: Semantic duplication: the second copy renames every variable and writes the discount as x - x*r instead of x*(1-r), so the blocks are not textually similar

_calibration.note: Modeled on st-duplicate-code, which rates semantic duplication that forces multi-site edits as error. Probe: node over 25025 quantity/price/rate cases, Math.round(x*(1-r)) and Math.round(x - x*r) differ in 108 because of floating-point rounding, so the copies already disagree on some invoices.
